sloka: इमे हि सर्वे स्नेहान्मामनुयाता यशस्विनः ।भक्ता हि भजितव्याश्च त्यक्तात्मानश्च मत्कृते ।। ७.११०.१७ ॥
transliteration: ime hi sarve snehānmāmanuyātā yaśasvinaḥ ।bhaktā hi bhajitavyāśca tyaktātmānaśca matkṛte ।। 7.110.17 ॥

translations.english: These glorious ones, all of whom have followed me out of affection, are indeed my devotees who have sacrificed their very selves for my sake and thus deserve to be honored.
